create_standard_robot: create a StandardRobot instance combining a robot arm, gripper, sensors, and effectors
position_gripper_with_ik: position the robot gripper to a target pose using inverse kinematics and a quaternion
position_arm_joints: set the robot arm joints to specific angles and optionally settle the physics simulation
compose_robot_with_standard_compose: compose a robot by attaching a gripper and optional wrist cameras to an arm
review_robot_abstract_class: review the Robot abstract base class and its required properties and methods for MOMA robots
